I told Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 25 November.

That date comes from Ilse's message in #north-team on 14 October, and nothing posted there since has changed it. Marcus is in that channel, so he could already see it. A renewal date is an account detail, not a finance figure, so sharing it with the North team needs no approval.

I couldn't check the date against a contract. There's still no Brackenwater account folder in the shared files, and I said so in the reply.
